HNSW Index

The HNSW index builds a navigable small-world graph for approximate nearest neighbor search.

Parameters

The ef parameter controls the size of the dynamic candidate list during search.

The M parameter controls the number of bidirectional links created for each element.

Usage

CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE v USING vss0(embedding(384));

Insert embeddings and query with the vss_search function.
